question:
On folding the given die, which letter will be opposite to the letter 'n'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e507a0942257806d4a37f18eb82fbec5ebdcdc3e367c43af7d47a07ef3ef4cf4.png]
solution:
On folding, the opposite sides of the respective faces are given as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a3d21abba4c4986ce59e5884d86291adecebf2a9042d0005c55fa53ca04b990.png] 

Therefore, the face opposite to the letter 'n' is 'j'. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
